name: GeCoNeRF
aliases: Neural Radiance Fields with Geometric Consistency
definition: A regularization framework for few-shot NeRF that enforces geometric consistency across views using depth-guided warping and feature-level consistency modeling to overcome under-constrained optimization and overfitting.
summary: GeCoNeRF is a few-shot NeRF regularization framework that enforces geometric consistency via depth-guided warping and feature-level modeling to preserve view-dependent effects without pre-training.
